UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user profile and safety preferences stored per authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

indianPhoneNumber.description: Optional Indian mobile number for local personalization.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred UI and AI response language.

callScreeningEnabled.description: Whether the user enabled call screening guidance.

privacyMinimizeStorage.description: Whether sensitive previews should be redacted before saving scan history.

ScanRecord.title: ScanRecord
ScanRecord.description: User-owned scam analysis scan history item.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

summary.description: Short summary of the scan result.

inputPreview.description: Truncated or privacy-redacted snippet of scanned content.

indicators.description: List of suspicious phrases or indicators.

CommunityReport.title: CommunityReport
CommunityReport.description: User-submitted unverified scam report for community awareness and phone/link lookup.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

description.description: Sanitized description of the scam attempt without personal PII.

reportedTarget.description: Normalized phone number, domain/URL, or scam handle if applicable.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and preferences document.

/users/{userId}/scanHistory/{scanId}.description: User-owned history of completed scam scans.

/communityReports/{reportId}.description: Community-submitted scam reports for India fraud trends and number/link checks.
